title: Mitra MCP | Mitra
excerpt: Let Claude and ChatGPT make calls from your number with Mitra. Watch the setup videos, connect with MCP, and book appointments, compare quotes, or follow up with customers.
content_html:
MCP

Let your AI agent
call from your number.

Connect Mitra to your AI app to make and answer calls from your number.

Imagine if Claude
could put Mitra to work

Once you connect Mitra, it can.

Call Juniper Bistro and reserve a table for four this Friday around 7 pm.

Called Juniper Bistro

Your table for four is booked for Friday at 7:15 pm. Juniper Bistro will hold the table for 15 minutes.

Do more with your AI apps

Ask Claude to call a few local plumbers, check availability, and compare prices.

Compare service quotes

Calling local plumbers…

Two options for this week

Thursday: $120.

Friday: $150.

You choose who to book.

Ask ChatGPT to call your dentist and book an appointment when you’re free.

Book an appointment

Calling your dentist…

Cleaning booked

Thursday at 2 pm.

Arrive 10 minutes early.

The appointment details are back in your chat.

Ask Grok to call Juniper Bistro and reserve a table for your group.

Make a reservation

Calling Juniper Bistro…

Table for four confirmed

Friday at 7:15 pm.

The table will be held for 15 minutes.

Your reservation is ready.

Ask Claude to call Maple Auto Repair and find out when your car will be ready.

Check on a repair

Calling Maple Auto Repair…

Ready to collect today

Your car will be ready at 4 pm.

Maple Auto Repair closes at 6 pm.

No need to make the call yourself.

Ask ChatGPT to call your client Maya Chen and book a showing at 24 Oak Lane.

Book a property showing

Calling Maya Chen…

Showing booked for tomorrow

Maya confirmed 10 am at 24 Oak Lane.

She’ll meet you at the front entrance.

The showing details are back in your chat.

How it works

1. Create a custom MCP connector

Custom MCP connector

Connect to Mitra

Use a custom connector.

Mitra

MCP server URLhttps://mcp.getmitra.com/mcp

Paste this URL into your AI app’s custom MCP server settings.

Read setup prompt

Help me connect Mitra to this AI app using its remote MCP server: https://mcp.getmitra.com/mcp Use OAuth and guide me through adding the server and signing into Mitra. If you cannot create the connection yourself, show me where to enter the URL in this app. The URL above is the server endpoint; getmitra.com/mcp is only the setup webpage. Do not say it is connected until you can show my Mitra account and assistants.

2. Sign in to Mitra

getmitra.com

Sign in to Mitra

Your Mitra, ready to help.

Continue

3. Put your Mitra to work

Call Juniper Bistro and book a table for four this Friday around 7 pm.

Called toolplace_call

Your table for four is booked for Friday at 7:15 pm. Juniper Bistro will hold it for 15 minutes.

Questions and answers

What is MCP?+

MCP is a way for the tools you use to talk to Mitra. Connect once, then ask Mitra to handle calls and bring the results back into your conversation.

What can I do with Mitra through MCP?+

Ask Mitra to make calls for you, like booking a dentist appointment, reserving a table, or checking when your car will be ready. You can also ask what happened on calls Mitra answered for you. Do it all from your AI app.

Which tools does this work with?+

Tools that support MCP, including ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. Look for the option to add a custom connector in your tool’s settings.

Is MCP on every plan?+

Yes. MCP is included in every Mitra free trial and paid plan. There’s no separate MCP add-on.
